an7.73:1.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave Sunetto nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo.
an7.73:1.2: Sunettassa kho pana bhikkhave satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ.
an7.73:1.3: Sunetto satthā sāvakānaṃ Brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ deseti.
an7.73:1.4: Ye kho pana bhikkhave Sunettassa satthuno Brahmalokasavyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni na pasādesuṃ, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
an7.73:1.5: Ye kho pana bhikkhave Sunettassa satthuno Brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni pasādesuṃ, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu. 2.
an7.73:2.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave Mūgapakkho nāma satthā ahosi . . .
an7.73:2.6: Arako nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo.
an7.73:2.7: Arakassa kho pana bhikkhave satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ.
an7.73:2.8: Arako nāma satthā sāvakānaṃ Brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ deseti.
an7.73:2.9: Ye kho pana bhikkhave Arakassa satthuno Brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni na pasādesuṃ, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
an7.73:2.10: Ye kho pana bhikkhave Arakassa satthuno Brahmalokasahavyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa cittāni pasādesuṃ, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu. 3.
an7.73:3.2: yo ime satta satthāre titthakare kāmesu vītarāge anekasataparivāre sasāvakasaṅghe duṭṭhacitto akkoseyya paribhāseyya, bahuṃ so apuññaṃ pasaveyyā ti?
an7.73:3.4: Yo kho bhikkhave ime satta satthāre titthakare kāmesu vītarāge anekasataparivāre sasāvakasaṅghe duṭṭhacitto akkoseyya paribhāseyya, bahuṃ so apuññaṃ pasaveyya,
an7.73:3.5: yo ekaṃ diṭṭhisampannaṃ puggalaṃ duṭṭhacitto akkosati paribhāsati, ayaṃ tato bahutaraṃ apuññaṃ pasavati.
an7.73:3.7: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave ito bahiddhā evarūpiṃ khantiṃ vadāmi yathā' maṃ sabrahmacārīsu.
an7.73:4.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ:--
an7.73:4.2: Na no sabrahmacārīsu cittāni paduṭṭhāni bhavissantī ti. Evaṃ
